verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of an official SDK that developers can build against. ELSTER's docs only say that third-party tax software 'die ELSTER unterstützt' can be used, which describes a sanctioned channel for other vendors' products rather than a documented SDK. The only developer-facing item is a probe naming an 'ERiC developer-artifact host' that failed to connect, which does not document SDK packages, languages, or usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
